Needs changes before merge.

I read the full diff against current upstream main. The diff includes the parent changes from #3990 and #3992.
The trial merge has PR head `114f7b171e035952993ed61f9fa0cca74e7d1d65` as its first parent.
The main base is `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.

The built-in colour values match the previous literals. The theme loader selects the correct defaults when the viewport ground changes.
The diff does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation.
No recorded program or golden file changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:748`: Correct the alpha conversion for a semi-transparent `viewport_hover` token.
   `Color32::r()`, `g()`, and `b()` return channels multiplied by alpha.
   `from_rgba_unmultiplied` multiplies those channels again. Thus, a legal `#rrggbbaa` theme value gives a darker facet fill.
   Read the channels with `to_srgba_unmultiplied()` before you set the fill alpha to 90.
   Add a test with a semi-transparent token.
   A separate probe with the compiled `ecolor` library confirms the defect for `#FF000080`:

   ```text
   token    [128, 0, 0, 128]
   actual   [45, 0, 0, 90]
   expected [90, 0, 0, 90]
   ```
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewcube.rs:333` and PR body, “Not exercised”: Add the required before/after screenshots to the PR body.
   Show the affected viewport elements before and after the change.
   Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not add images to this PR branch.
3. `crates/ui/tests/colour_literals.rs:1` and `crates/ui/tests/theme_viewport_inks.rs:1`: Explain the two new test binaries in the PR body.
   Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “New tests join a directory suite”, requires a one-line reason for each new top-level test file.
   These files come from the parent PRs, but they remain additions in this diff against main.
   Put the tests in an existing directory suite, or add the required reasons to the body.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The review items on 114f7b171 are done. The new head is eef05252f. The merge e49b5a20f brings in the #3990 and #3992 fixes.

1. **Alpha of the facet veil.** Thank you for the probe. The veil is now `ground_ink::facet_veil(viewport_hover)`. It reads the colour with `to_srgba_unmultiplied()`, then sets alpha 90. The test `the_facet_veil_keeps_the_hover_colour_of_a_semi_transparent_token` checks that the built-in gold gives the old veil, and that `#FF000080` gives `[90, 0, 0, 90]`. With the old channel read, the test fails with `[45, 0, 0, 90]`, the value of your probe.
2. **UI evidence.** The PR body now has before and after screenshots of the same scenes as #3992 (handles, view cube and picked points, dark and light). The images are on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork. A pixel comparison of each pair gives 0 different pixels. The images do not show the playback marker or the hover gold, because they show only during playback or under the pointer; the tests pin those values.
3. **Test placement.** The tests are in the module `tests/theme_files/viewport_inks.rs` of the existing `theme_files` suite.

Gate on eef05252f: quick gate 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean.

Ready for a re-check.

The review is clean. No blocking finding remains.

I checked the three findings in the previous review and the author's reply:

1. **Fixed — facet alpha.** Commit `eef05252f` adds `ground_ink::facet_veil` and reads the colour with `to_srgba_unmultiplied()`. The shell uses this function. The test `the_facet_veil_keeps_the_hover_colour_of_a_semi_transparent_token` passed locally. It checks the built-in gold and the `#FF000080` case, which now gives `[90, 0, 0, 90]`.
2. **Fixed — screenshots.** The body has four before/after pairs on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. I downloaded all eight images and inspected the four scenes. Each pair has zero different pixels at 1280 × 720. The scenes show the cube, handles and picked points in both themes. The body states that the images do not show the playback marker or hover colour. The tests check those token values.
3. **Fixed — test placement.** Commits `e4b71bb0d` and `c8103e462`, included through `e49b5a20f`, move the tests into the existing `theme_files` suite. This diff adds no test binary.

I read the full diff against current upstream main, including the parent changes from #3990 and #3992. I used upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`. The built-in colour values match the previous literals. The loader keeps the correct defaults when the viewport ground changes. I found no new blocker.
